title: Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Water Treatment Equipment at the Municipal Water Works
summary: Risk indicators for T-001: 1 rule finding (F-1: contradiction); no bidder belongs to a flagged ring. Risk level: medium.
reasoning: Finding [F-1] shows that the formalized clauses CL2 and CL5 conflict: no vendor can hold turnover of at least 50 cr and at most 10 cr at the same time. Supporting guideline: [KB-001] (eligibility criteria should be fair and non-restrictive). No network ring is linked to the bidders of this tender.
recommended_actions: Ask the tendering authority to clarify clauses CL2 and CL5 or issue a corrigendum.
Review the amendment history of the tender document.
disclaimer: Risk indicators only; not a finding of wrongdoing. Recommendation requires human review.
